userStories.title: Config reader for [models] and [backend] with defaults
userStories.description: As the cam runtime, I need a typed reader for per-phase model and backend keys in the project config scripts/cam/project.toml (project-scoped, resolved from cwd; the per-user ~/.config/cam/config.toml is NOT consulted for models/backend), with safe defaults on missing or malformed input, so all spawn sites can resolve {phase, model, backend} from a single source of truth.
acceptanceCriteria: New file src/config/models.ts exports readPhaseModel(phase, configPath?) and readBackend(configPath?), mirroring the try/catch/default pattern of src/config/permission-mode.ts:47-61. [oracle: file-assert: grep -q 'export function readPhaseModel' src/config/models.ts && grep -q 'export function readBackend' src/config/models.ts]

DEFAULTS map sets orchestrator/planner/auditor/reviewer to claude-opus-4-8, implementer and ship to claude-sonnet-4-6, and the backend default to claude; a bun test imports the map and asserts each value, including DEFAULTS.backend === 'claude'. [oracle: bun test test/config/models.test.ts]

Phase type union covers exactly orchestrator, planner, auditor, implementer, reviewer, ship. [oracle: file-assert: grep -q 'orchestrator' src/config/models.ts && grep -q 'planner' src/config/models.ts && grep -q 'auditor' src/config/models.ts && grep -q 'implementer' src/config/models.ts && grep -q 'reviewer' src/config/models.ts && grep -q 'ship' src/config/models.ts]
Reader falls back to default on missing file, missing section, missing key, malformed TOML, and non-string value (5 paths). [oracle: bun test test/config/models.test.ts]

The default config path is scripts/cam/project.toml resolved from process.cwd(); the optional configPath argument overrides it (used by tests). The per-user ~/.config/cam/config.toml and CAM_CONFIG_PATH (which target the user config in permission-mode.ts) are NOT consulted for models/backend. [oracle: bun test test/config/models.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Files: src/config/models.ts (new), test/config/models.test.ts (new). Mirror the try/catch/default CODE pattern of src/config/permission-mode.ts:47-61, but NOT its file target: permission-mode reads the per-user ~/.config/cam/config.toml via defaultConfigPath()/CAM_CONFIG_PATH; models/backend are PROJECT-scoped and read scripts/cam/project.toml resolved from process.cwd(). Do not overload CAM_CONFIG_PATH. The configPath? param (default join(cwd,'scripts/cam/project.toml')) is the test seam; no env override needed. Bun.TOML.parse already returns full TOML (toml.ts:111); the writer at toml.ts:68-97 already supports single-level [section] tables of scalars, so no toml.ts change is needed for reading. Patterns: noUncheckedIndexedAccess (guard array/object access), Bun runtime, never block the loop on malformed config (defensive defaults like permission-mode.ts).

userStories.title: Rewrite frontmatter model: line for in-session phases (planner, auditor, ship) on config save
userStories.description: As an operator, I need `cam config` saves for planner/auditor/ship phases to actually take effect, since those phases run as Task subagents / slash steps where cam cannot pass --model, so the chosen model must be written into the model: frontmatter line of the project-local .claude/ runtime files the harness resolves them from.
acceptanceCriteria: On `cam config` save, the planner phase choice rewrites the model: line in the project-local .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md (resolved from cwd). [oracle: bun test test/commands/config-frontmatter.test.ts]
Same for auditor (.claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md) and ship (.claude/commands/cam-ship.md). [oracle: bun test test/commands/config-frontmatter.test.ts]

The frontmatter rewriter is a pure helper (string in, string out) that changes only the single model: line; all other frontmatter keys and the body are preserved byte-for-byte; the test injects string in/out with no fs. [oracle: bun test test/commands/config-frontmatter.test.ts]

The save targets ONLY the three project-local .claude/ runtime files; a test asserts none of the rewriter's target paths is under templates/ (templates/ defaults are owned by US-004; no embed-vendor coupling here). [oracle: bun test test/commands/config-frontmatter.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Files: src/commands/config.ts (call the writer on save), src/templates/frontmatter.ts (new pure helper rewriting the single `model: <value>` line via a scoped regex), .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md, .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md, .claude/commands/cam-ship.md (the runtime targets, resolved from cwd), test/commands/config-frontmatter.test.ts (new). SCOPE DECISION: rewrite ONLY the project-local .claude/ files. A user project (post cam init) has no templates/ dir at all; templates/ exists only in the cam-cli source repo and holds the shipped opus-4-8 DEFAULTS (owned by US-004), NOT the operator's per-project override. So this story does NOT touch templates/ and has NO embed-vendor coupling. Use a scoped regex over the model: line, NOT js-yaml (CAM-69 rule: a bare js-yaml import auto-installs ESM-only v5 in a node_modules-less context and breaks). The pure rewriter is the testable seam; tests inject string in/out, no fs touch. Expose the target-path list so the test can assert none is under templates/.
